conservation.owner_class_definition.definition: owner classes used in this module
conservation.owner_class_definition.value: Federal = USFS BLM NPS FWS BOR OTHER FEDERAL UNDEFINED FEDERAL; Tribal/BIA = BIA TRIBAL; State = STATE; Private = PRIVATE; State or private = STATE OR PRIVATE; County/local = COUNTY MUNICIPAL/LOCAL; Missing = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED (OWNER_DESCR upper-cased)

coverage.break_years_by_state.definition: flagged break years per STATE with the count ratio to the prior non-zero year

coverage.federal_agency_break_years_1992.definition: break years (same rule) in the national count series of each federal reporting agency, 1992-2019
coverage.federal_agency_break_years_1992.note: 2020 is excluded because of the IA-IRWIN switch.

coverage.ia_irwin_switch_2020.definition: records with NWCG_REPORTING_AGENCY == IA in 2020 versus earlier years, FS records in 2019 and 2020, and records by SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE in 2019 and 2020
coverage.ia_irwin_switch_2020.note: In 2020 the federal source systems (FS-FIRESTAT, DOI-WFMI) were replaced by IA-IRWIN, so SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE jumps from FED to INTERAGCY. NWCG_REPORTING_AGENCY is preserved (FS still has thousands of 2020 records and IA only a handful), so agency-level series must use NWCG_REPORTING_AGENCY, and SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE series break at 2020.

coverage.n_states.definition: distinct STATE values (states, DC and territories)

coverage.n_states_ge_1000_records.definition: STATE values with at least 1,000 records

coverage.n_states_ge_1000_with_break.definition: same, among STATE values with at least 1,000 records

coverage.n_states_with_break.definition: STATE values with at least one flagged break year (rule in coverage.rule)

coverage.national_fires_by_year_all_vs_m.definition: fires per FIRE_YEAR over all state-years and over usable state-years only, with the number of states contributing
coverage.national_fires_by_year_all_vs_m.note: The masked series is not a national series either: the set of contributing states changes by year.

coverage.nonfed_share_by_year.definition: share of records with SOURCE_SYSTEM_TYPE == NONFED by year

coverage.rule.definition: the coverage_ok rule as implemented in analysis/coverage.py
coverage.rule.value: break on year y if count(y) / count(prior non-zero year) > 3 or < 1/3 and max(count(y), count(prior)) >= 30; zero-count years flagged and never usable; usable window = longest run of consecutive non-zero years containing no break year after its first year (ties to the most recent run); coverage_ok(state, year) = year inside the usable window

coverage.share_acres_in_usable_window.definition: share of all acres whose state-year lies inside the state usable window

coverage.share_records_in_usable_window.definition: share of all records whose state-year lies inside the state usable window

coverage.share_records_in_window_by_regi.definition: share of a region-year's records that lie inside their state usable window

coverage.states_with_interior_zero_years.definition: STATE values with a zero-count year between their first and last year with records

coverage.window_length_years.definition: length of the usable window in years across STATE values

ics.cause_agreement_all_matched.definition: matched incidents by FPA FOD NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION (largest joined fire) and ICS-209-PLUS CAUSE (H Human, L Lightning, U Unknown, O Other)

ics.cause_agreement_share.definition: share of incidents where both sources record a cause and agree (Human vs Natural/Lightning)

ics.distinct_incidents_matched.definition: distinct incident ids among matched rows (several FPA FOD fires can share one incident, e.g. complexes)

ics.evacuations_by_form_era.definition: evacuation reporting split at the 2014 ICS-209 form change: 2010-2013 has a yes/no EVACUATION_REPORTED flag for every incident, 2014-2020 has PEAK_EVACUATIONS (a count, null when none reported) and the flag is derived from it
ics.evacuations_by_form_era.note: The two eras are not comparable; the data dictionary says EVACUATION_REPORTED is "2002+ only, 2014+ set to true if PEAK_EVACUATIONS > 0".

ics.field_fill_rates_sample.definition: share of sample incidents with a non-null value for each ICS-209-PLUS field
ics.field_fill_rates_sample.note: STR_DESTROYED_TOTAL and FATALITIES include zeros by construction (data dictionary: "zero values included"), so a missing report and a true zero cannot be told apart. STR_THREATENED_MAX, WF_PEAK_PERSONNEL, PROJECTED_FINAL_IM_COST and PEAK_EVACUATIONS are null when never reported.

ics.final_acres_vs_fod_acres.definition: ICS-209-PLUS FINAL_ACRES divided by the sum of FIRE_SIZE over the joined FPA FOD fires

ics.fod_rows_matched.definition: FPA FOD rows whose ICS_209_PLUS_INCIDENT_JOIN_ID equals an INCIDENT_ID in the ICS-209-PLUS incident table

ics.fod_rows_with_join_id.definition: FPA FOD rows with a non-empty ICS_209_PLUS_INCIDENT_JOIN_ID

ics.incident_type_counts.definition: INCTYP_ABBREVIATION counts (WF wildfire, WFU wildland fire use, RX prescribed, CX complex)

ics.largest_fod_id_agreement.definition: share of matched incidents where the largest joined FPA FOD fire (by FIRE_SIZE) is the one ICS-209-PLUS lists in LRGST_FOD_ID

ics.match_rate_by_year.definition: FPA FOD rows, rows with a join id, matched rows and match shares by FIRE_YEAR; the _ge_300 columns restrict to FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres

ics.outcomes_by_cause.definition: outcomes by FPA FOD NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION of the largest joined fire

ics.outcomes_by_general_cause.definition: outcomes by NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE of the largest joined fire

ics.outcomes_by_owner_class.definition: outcomes by owner class of the largest joined fire (Federal = USFS BLM NPS FWS BOR OTHER FEDERAL UNDEFINED FEDERAL; Tribal/BIA = BIA TRIBAL; State = STATE; Private = PRIVATE; State or private = STATE OR PRIVATE; County/local = COUNTY MUNICIPAL/LOCAL; Missing = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED (OWNER_DESCR upper-cased))

ics.outcomes_by_region.definition: outcomes by project region of the largest joined fire

ics.outcomes_total.note: structures_threatened_max_sum sums the per-incident maximum, so it is not a count of distinct structures. Fractional structure counts occur because ICS-209-PLUS splits complex-level totals evenly across member incidents.

ics.sample_definition.definition: the sample used by every ics.outcomes_* claim
ics.sample_definition.value: ICS-209-PLUS incidents joined to FPA FOD via ICS_209_PLUS_INCIDENT_JOIN_ID, one row per incident, FPA FOD attributes from the largest joined fire, FIRE_YEAR 2010-2020, FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres

ics.sample_n.definition: ICS-209-PLUS incidents joined to FPA FOD via ICS_209_PLUS_INCIDENT_JOIN_ID, one row per incident, FPA FOD attributes from the largest joined fire, FIRE_YEAR 2010-2020, FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres

ics.structures_destroyed_by_region_cause.definition: structures destroyed by region and cause classification

ics.structures_destroyed_distribution.definition: distribution of STR_DESTROYED_TOTAL over the sample

ics.top25_composition.definition: cause, owner class and state counts among the top 25

ics.top25_structures_destroyed.definition: the 25 sample incidents with the most structures destroyed

2.NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE: Misuse of fire by a minor

padus.agency_exact_agreement.definition: share of ignitions with OWNER_DESCR == agency whose PAD-US Mang_Name is the matching code (USFS, BLM, NPS, FWS as is; BOR = USBR; BIA = TRIB)

padus.agency_vs_mang_name_counts.definition: ignitions whose OWNER_DESCR is a federal agency or BIA, by PAD-US Mang_Name at the point (columns with < 500 pooled into other)

padus.by_gap_2010_2020.definition: gap = GAP status at the ignition point (1 most protected ... 4, none = not in PAD-US, unmatched = outside the layer); fires = count, acres = sum FIRE_SIZE; human_share_known_cause = Human / (Human + Natural); fires_ge_300 = FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres; FIRE_YEAR 2010-2020

padus.by_gap_2010_2020_human_only.definition: gap = GAP status at the ignition point (1 most protected ... 4, none = not in PAD-US, unmatched = outside the layer); fires = count, acres = sum FIRE_SIZE; human_share_known_cause = Human / (Human + Natural); fires_ge_300 = FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres; FIRE_YEAR 2010-2020, Human cause only

padus.by_gap_all_years.definition: gap = GAP status at the ignition point (1 most protected ... 4, none = not in PAD-US, unmatched = outside the layer); fires = count, acres = sum FIRE_SIZE; human_share_known_cause = Human / (Human + Natural); fires_ge_300 = FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres; all records 1992-2020

padus.fires_by_block_gap.definition: ignitions by 5-year block (last block 2017-2020) and gap

padus.general_cause_share_gap12_2010_202.definition: share of ignitions by NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE on GAP 1-2 land, 2010-2020

padus.human_ignitions_by_manager_2010_20.definition: Human ignitions 2010-2020 inside PAD-US units by Mang_Name

padus.human_ignitions_share_in_tribal_un.definition: share of human ignitions inside PAD-US units 2010-2020 that fall in Des_Tp TRIBL units

padus.join_definition.value: ignition point (LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, EPSG:4326) projected to the layer CRS (USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic USGS version, EPSG:5070 for CONUS; the AK and HI layers use their own Albers) and joined with geopandas.sjoin predicate within; where a point fell in more than one polygon the lowest GAP status was kept and the multiplicity recorded in n_overlaps. gap = GAP_Sts for PAD-US polygons, "none" for Non-PAD-US Area fill polygons, "unmatched" for points in no polygon (offshore, PR, bad coordinates).

padus.match_summary.note: n_overlaps is 1 for every matched point because the Vector Analysis file is already a flat partition; USGS resolved the overlaps by GAP priority before publication.

padus.missing_owner_assignment_2010_2020.definition: records with OWNER_DESCR = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED, by PAD-US Mang_Type at the point (Not in PAD-US = Non-PAD-US Area, which is predominantly private land)

padus.missing_owner_assignment_all_years.definition: records with OWNER_DESCR = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED, by PAD-US Mang_Type at the point (Not in PAD-US = Non-PAD-US Area, which is predominantly private land)

padus.missing_owner_by_gap_all_years.definition: records with missing OWNER_DESCR by gap

padus.missing_owner_by_reporting_agency_.definition: missing-owner records by NWCG_REPORTING_AGENCY and PAD-US Mang_Type

padus.missing_owner_top_managers_all_yea.definition: PAD-US Mang_Name for missing-owner records that fall inside a PAD-US unit

padus.n_points.definition: ignition points submitted to the join

padus.n_units_with_human_ignitions_2010_.definition: distinct Unit_Nm with at least one human ignition 2010-2020

padus.owner_agreement_by_class.definition: share of each owner class whose PAD-US manager type is consistent: Federal = ['FED']; Tribal/BIA = ['TRIB']; State = ['STAT']; County/local = ['DIST', 'LOC']; Private = ['NGO', 'Not in PAD-US', 'PVT']; State or private = ['NGO', 'Not in PAD-US', 'PVT', 'STAT']

padus.owner_vs_mang_type_counts.definition: ignitions with a recorded OWNER_DESCR by owner class (rows, Federal = USFS BLM NPS FWS BOR OTHER FEDERAL UNDEFINED FEDERAL; Tribal/BIA = BIA TRIBAL; State = STATE; Private = PRIVATE; State or private = STATE OR PRIVATE; County/local = COUNTY MUNICIPAL/LOCAL; Missing = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED (OWNER_DESCR upper-cased)) and PAD-US Mang_Type at the point (columns; Not in PAD-US = Non-PAD-US Area)

padus.owner_vs_mang_type_row_shares.definition: row shares of the previous table

padus.share_acres_by_block_gap.definition: row shares of the acres table

padus.source.value: PAD-US 4.1 Vector Analysis file (PADUS4_1VectorAnalysis_CONUS/AK/HI.gdb, inside the Raster Analysis zips on ScienceBase item 6759b67ed34edfeb8710a3db): the Combined Fee/Designation/Easement feature class with Military Lands and Tribal Areas from the Proclamation feature class, overlapping designations resolved by GAP status priority (GAP 1 over 2 over 3 over 4), clipped to Census state boundaries, with Non-PAD-US Area fill polygons. Puerto Rico and the territories are not covered.

padus.top25_gap12_units_human_ignitions_.definition: same table restricted to units whose modal GAP status is 1 or 2

padus.top25_nontribal_units_human_igniti.definition: same table excluding units whose modal Des_Tp is TRIBL (tribal reservations and statistical areas)

padus.top25_units_human_ignitions_2010_2.definition: PAD-US units (Unit_Nm) with the most Human-cause ignitions 2010-2020; Mang_Name, Mang_Type, GAP_Sts and Des_Tp are the modal values across the unit's ignitions; peak_month = DISCOVERY_MONTH with the most human ignitions; states = STATE values holding at least 2% of the unit's human ignitions
padus.top25_units_human_ignitions_2010_2.note: A unit name can repeat across states (e.g. "State Trust Land"); rows are by name only. Oklahoma Tribal Statistical Areas (Des_Tp TRIBL) are Census-defined tribal jurisdictions that include private land, not conservation units.

padus.top25_units_share_of_human_ignitio.definition: share of all human ignitions inside PAD-US units 2010-2020 that fall in the top 25 units
